notes: Single shared reviewed-answer corpus consumed by conformance/run.mjs (web and Action) and conformance/run_py.py (published skill). For every dns-engine fixture, legacy present/absent assertions remain active and expect.findings is a closed list: area, title, severity, action, and fixIncludes (or explicit null) are asserted. expect.score is the exact bucket + DKIM-state + gap + note object; a true null MX uses explicit null for the inbound-only MTA_STS, TLS_RPT, and DANE buckets. Surface-specific findings require surfaces plus a documented notApplicable reason for every omitted shipping surface. No expectation-regeneration mode exists. Non-dns-engine modes remain explicitly skipped with a reason.

notApplicable.web: The edge engine cannot open port 25 for a live STARTTLS probe.
notApplicable.action: The vendored JS engine intentionally omits live port-25 STARTTLS probing.

findings.title: DKIM not found at common/provider selectors
findings.fixIncludes: Confirm the selector with the sending provider; if genuinely unsigned, enable DKIM at

findings.title: No TLS-RPT
findings.fixIncludes: Add _smtp._tls TXT: "v=TLSRPTv1; rua=mailto:tlsrpt@<domain>".

findings.title: No BIMI
findings.action: Get a VMC, then publish BIMI
findings.fixIncludes: Once DMARC is enforced, publish default._bimi with an SVG logo (+ VMC for Gmail/Apple).

findings.title: No DANE/TLSA
findings.fixIncludes: If DNSSEC is enabled, publish TLSA records for the MX; otherwise enable DNSSEC first.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled
findings.fixIncludes: Enable DNSSEC at your DNS provider (it's also the prerequisite for DANE).

findings.title: No CAA records
findings.fixIncludes: Publish a CAA record naming your CA(s), e.g. 0 issue "letsencrypt.org".
